description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeysServerInternal class, specifically testing its creation and error handling scenarios within the Rialto media server component. It uses Google Test framework macros to define test cases that verify object creation, failure conditions, and interactions with mocked dependencies.

classes.name: RialtoServerCreateMediaKeysTest
classes.description: Test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysTestBase, used for testing MediaKeysServerInternal creation and failure scenarios.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Test that a MediaKeysServerInternal object can be successfully created with valid dependencies.

methods.name: GetMainThreadFailure
methods.description: Test that creation throws an exception if getMainThread() returns nullptr, indicating failure to obtain the main thread.

methods.name: CreateOcdmSystemFailure
methods.description: Test that creation throws an exception if createOcdmSystem() returns nullptr, indicating failure to create the Ocdm system.
